answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to submit original reasoning each epoch that a jury of peers grades for coherence and novelty. An attacker must pay the full inference cost to produce distinct high-quality text for every fake identity, because copied or low-effort answers score zero and earn nothing. On a terrace where a sparrow rides the zephyr, this continuous unique cognitive work multiplies the expense of large-scale fake-identity farms.
